title: SAD promises power to industry at Rs 5 per unit, Build Punjab Dept
description: Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) president Sukhbir Singh Badal on Friday announced that an SAD government would provide electricity to the industrial sector at Rs 5 per unit and establish a dedicated Build Punjab department to ensure time-bound clearances for builders. He also promised a new IT policy, with priority to developing Amritsar and Mohali as IT hubs and promoting data centres and artificial intelligence (AI) facilities in the state.

title: Wall Street drops to its worst day since June after the sell-off for tech stocks deepens
description: Wall Streets tech sell-off deepened on Friday as investors questioned whether massive spending on artificial intelligence will deliver enough returns to justify lofty valuations. The S&P 500 fell 1.8% and the Nasdaq 2.9%, with Intel plunging nearly 29% and Nvidia down 4.2%, while bitcoin also slid after a major hack at Binance.
